title: 14 CFR § 89.120 Operations for aeronautical research or to show compliance with regulations. (2025 edition)

heading_path: 14 CFR § 89.120 Operations for aeronautical research or to show compliance with regulations. (2025 edition)
sections.text: The Administrator may authorize operations without remote identification where the operation is solely for the purpose of aeronautical research or to show compliance with regulations.
